prompt_strategy.name: strategy
prompt_strategy.prompt:
# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value: Basically, a strategy I used during this game consisted of identifying each character through symbolism. For instance, for the characters, if one had purple hair to the right and black shoes, I would identify it as "purple right, black shoes." I only changed my strategy when the non-characters showed and that was generally through looking at what the characteristic is showing.

prompt_mistake.name: mistake
prompt_mistake.prompt:
# Describe the reasons for any mistakes

Did you make any mistakes in remembering the names you gave to the images?

If so, please describe what you think caused them. For example, typos, mixing up similar images, etc. 

If you didn't make any mistakes, you can type "none".
prompt_mistake.value: I think some mistakes were shown in the non-character section. For instance, the black cubes and the way some of the shapes were kicking up, I kept mistaking it for kicking or jumping when me and my partner didn't write the names for those. Also, I did get some typos wrong. Instead of saying grey square, I said white square instead.

prompt_working_together.name: working_together
prompt_working_together.prompt:
# How did you and your partner divide the work of coming up with names?

For example, did you both suggest names, take turns, have one person take the lead, or use some other approach?
prompt_working_together.value: We both kinda suggested the names. My partner did take the lead, but I was recommending some typical names that could be obvious for us to incorporate throughout the characters so we can get points.

# Describe the reasons for any mistakes

Did you make any mistakes in remembering the names you gave to the images?

If so, please describe what you think caused them. For example, typos, mixing up similar images, etc. 

If you didn't make any mistakes, you can type "none".
prompt_mistake.value: My first mistake was a typo, then we were pretty consistent. At the end, the partner seemed to misremember some of the images.

prompt_working_together.name: working_together
prompt_working_together.prompt:
# How did you and your partner divide the work of coming up with names?

For example, did you both suggest names, take turns, have one person take the lead, or use some other approach?
prompt_working_together.value: We both suggested names, but I felt like I took a bit more of the lead.

prompt_labeling_1a.name: labeling_1a
prompt_labeling_1a.prompt:
As a group, come up with labels for each of these images, and enter them in the shared text box below.

Names should be short, easy to remember, and unique to each image.

In the next stage, we will quiz you on the names you chose.

👉 You earn points only if **everyone** in your group remembers the correct name.
